build_biknn_radius_graph: build a BiKNN radius graph from an AtomicData object with PBC image replication and soft or hard k-nearest neighbor ranking
build_batched_radius_graph: build a batched BiKNN radius graph for multiple systems by concatenating per-system edge indices, displacements, and envelope values
build_radius_graph_single: build a BiKNN radius graph for a single system given atomic positions, cell tensor, image IDs, and cutoff distance
build_radius_graph_chunked: build a memory-efficient chunked BiKNN radius graph that processes source atoms in configurable chunks to reduce peak memory usage
compute_segment_argsort_vectorized: compute the argsort of values within each segment using a vectorized cumsum trick instead of a Python loop
